description: Resume-Job Description Match Tool - Compare resumes against job postings to identify skill gaps, keyword matches, and compatibility scores. Public access, multiple input methods.

userStories.title: Create JobMatchAnalysis TypeScript types
userStories.description: As a developer, I need type definitions for the job match analysis response before implementing the API or UI.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/types/job-match.ts
Define JobMatchRequest interface with: resumeText (string), jobDescription (string), locale (string)
Define JobMatchAnalysis interface with: matchScore (number 0-100), matchedSkills (string[]), missingSkills (string[]), recommendations (string[]), strengths (string[]), analyzedAt (string ISO date)
Export all types
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Created src/types/job-match.ts with JobMatchRequest, JobMatchAnalysis interfaces.

userStories.title: Define AI job match analysis prompt
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a prompt that compares resume text against job description and returns structured match analysis.
acceptanceCriteria: Add buildJobMatchAnalysisPrompt function to src/lib/ai/prompts.ts
Prompt accepts resumeText (string) and jobDescription (string)
Prompt instructs AI to: extract skills from job description, compare against resume skills, calculate match percentage, identify gaps and strengths
Prompt instructs AI to return valid JSON matching JobMatchAnalysis type
Include guidance for realistic scoring (not inflated)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Added buildJobMatchAnalysisPrompt to prompts.ts with skill extraction, matching, and realistic scoring.

userStories.title: Create job match analysis API endpoint
userStories.description: As a developer, I need an API endpoint that accepts resume text and job description and returns match analysis.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/app/api/tools/match-resume-job/route.ts
POST endpoint accepts JSON body with: resumeText, jobDescription, locale
Validate inputs with Zod: resumeText min 200 chars, jobDescription min 100 chars
Call Groq API with job match prompt
Parse AI response as JSON and validate against JobMatchAnalysis type
Return analysis JSON on success
Handle errors: validation (400), AI failure (500)
No authentication required (public endpoint)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Created /api/tools/match-resume-job with Zod validation, Groq SDK integration, public access.
